items.title: Drag utilization toward 100%. Watch wait time stop being polite.
items.description: Reproduces the exact M/M/1 formula verified in L3 (service rate fixed at 10 req/sec, matching the unit's own worked table). Drag the arrival rate slider — notice how little the wait time moves through most of the range, then how sharply it rises as arrival rate approaches the service rate.
items.compute: const serviceRate = 10; const avgTimeInSystem = 1 / (serviceRate - params.arrivalRate); return { avgTimeInSystem: Math.round(avgTimeInSystem * 1000) / 1000 };
